title: Send the transit request to Diamond State Networks / OzarksGo
detail: The draft is in Gmail: add your name and phone, then send. The path-B template goes to the contact forms of 2–3 other carriers.

title: Engage cooperative/securities counsel and a co-op CPA
detail: The counsel inquiry draft is in Gmail. Send it to 2–3 firms, pick one, and sign the engagement letter.

title: Name the two head-end (internet on-ramp) locations
detail: Your two known internet-buy locations, or candidate parcels near them.

title: Confirm the pilot zones
detail: Prairie Creek, Beaver Shores and Monte Ne, as ranked.

title: Recruit the founding board / incorporators
detail: Neighbors, a marina owner, and someone with finance experience.

title: Decide the legal form with counsel
detail: Telecommunications cooperative vs general cooperative; confirm whether tenure-weighted voting is allowed.

title: Send the Army Corps introduction
detail: A letter to the Little Rock District about the Beaver Lake Shoreline Management Plan, requesting a meeting.

title: File the Articles, get the EIN, open bank and escrow accounts
File the ARIN and FCC registrations
detail: ARIN organization, AS number and IPv6; FCC registration number. Both need the EIN.

title: Score the transit quotes and update the model
detail: Quotes go into the provider scorecard; transit sizing and the pro forma are re-run.

title: Submit pole-attachment applications
detail: Ozarks Electric, Carroll Electric and SWEPCO.

title: Field-verify the pilot
detail: Walk the tower sites, survey the first lake crossing, and sign the first host-site agreements.

title: Sign purchase options on the head-end parcels
Get radio demos and quotes; decide the short lake crossings
detail: Tarana first, plus one line-of-sight vendor; watchdog and surge standard on every install.

title: Open the member-capital campaign in the pilot zones
detail: Once counsel approves the documents: portal on real hosting, live Stripe, escrow account.

title: Meet lenders
detail: CoBank, RTFC and a local bank, with the data room.

title: Make an offer to a network/RF engineer
90-day review: pilot go/no-go readiness
detail: The gate: pilot zones at 25% reservations and $75 per premises committed, both transit paths signed, first permits in hand, financing committed.
